kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بِرَنْج or بَرِنْج or بَرَنْج • (biranj or barinj or baranj) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Persian برنگ (berang), from Sanskrit विडङ्ग (viḍaṅga), विडङ्गा (viḍaṅgā), also in Classical Syriac ܒܪܢܓ (brng), and more directly borrowed into Arabic as فِلَنْجَة (filanja).
g: baobarang, false black pepper (Embelia ribes; also Embelia tsjeriam-cottam syn. Embelia robusta)

kaikki_vikisozluk.t:

g: ʿajʿaja form of بَرْنِيّ (barniyy, a sort of date)
